# Smartspanner CMMS - Full AI Context

> Smartspanner is cloud-based CMMS software for maintenance management, work orders, preventive maintenance, asset tracking, facilities management, inventory, inspections, and IoT condition monitoring.

## Canonical URLs

- Website: https://www.smartspanner.com/
- App: https://app.smartspanner.com

## Company

Smartspanner is a UK-based CMMS software company founded in 2013 and based in Gateshead, United Kingdom.

- Company name: Smartspanner
- Product name: Smartspanner CMMS
- Category: Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)
- Address: Unit 3 Queens Court, Team Valley Industrial Estate, Gateshead, NE11 0BU, United Kingdom
- Sales email: sales@smartspanner.com
- Phone: +44 (0) 191 300 1217
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartspanner

## Product Summary

Smartspanner helps maintenance teams move from spreadsheets, paper records, and reactive maintenance into a structured maintenance management system. It combines SME-friendly simplicity with enterprise-ready capability, allowing organisations to introduce multi-site controls, inventory governance, reporting, APIs, and other advanced features according to their requirements.

The product supports planned preventive maintenance, reactive work orders, asset registers, QR code asset labels, checklists and inspections, permits to work, spare parts inventory, purchase orders, subcontractor management, failure code tracking, performance dashboards, API access, IoT condition monitoring, and a multi-language app interface.

## Primary Use Cases

- Replace maintenance spreadsheets with a CMMS
- Manage reactive and planned work orders
- Schedule preventive maintenance and inspections
- Track equipment, assets, sites, locations, and asset history
- Give technicians mobile access to maintenance tasks
- Manage maintenance across multiple sites
- Control spare parts and consumables across sites with categories, BIN locations, replenishment rules, intelligent perpetual counting, inventory health, and purchase orders
- Standardize procedures and maintenance checklists
- Manage UK-aligned permits to work for higher-risk maintenance tasks, with mobile signature capture, PDF export for wet signatures, email sharing, and links to one or more CMMS users
- Record failure codes for root cause analysis
- Coordinate subcontractor maintenance work
- Monitor vibration, temperature, power consumption, flow, and machine health
- Prepare maintenance reports and KPI dashboards
- Manage fire risk assessment observations and corrective actions
- Support app users who prefer English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, or Japanese
- Translate supported user-entered maintenance content, including procedures, checklists, instructions, descriptions, and comments, into each user's app language while keeping the original accessible

## Core Features

- Work order management: create, assign, schedule, prioritize, and close maintenance work.
- Preventive maintenance: automate recurring maintenance tasks, servicing, inspections, and compliance work.
- Asset management: maintain asset records, hierarchy, locations, history, linked parts, and documents.
- Mobile CMMS: iOS and Android apps for technicians in the field.
- Multi-site maintenance: deploy across multiple sites with site-level permissions and dashboards.
- Spare parts and inventory: structure stock with categories and BIN locations, apply replenishment and verification rules, automate daily cycle-counting workloads, monitor site Stock Control, and compare organisation-wide Inventory Performance.
- Purchase orders: create and manage maintenance purchase orders and goods receipts.
- Checklists and inspections: capture inspection responses, notes, comments, and media.
- Permits to work: create UK-aligned permit-to-work records, capture signatures on mobile or tablet, generate PDFs for wet signatures, email permits, and link each permit to one or more Smartspanner users.
- Procedures: standardize repeatable maintenance procedures and attach supporting documents.
- Subcontractors: track external maintenance teams, costs, and related files.
- Failure codes: tag work orders with failure codes for analysis and reporting.
- Dashboards and reporting: view overdue work, breakdowns, requests, stock issues, trends, and KPIs.
- Lockout/tagout: record lockout activity, lock IDs, and reasons.
- IoT condition monitoring: use wireless sensors for vibration, temperature, energy, flow, and machine health.
- Integrations and API: connect Smartspanner data to Power BI, Excel, Python, ERP systems, and other reporting tools.
- Multi-language app interface: support English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, and Japanese users in the Smartspanner app.
- In-app translation: supported procedures, checklists, instructions, descriptions, and comments can be shown in each user's selected language while retaining access to the original text.

## Language Support

The Smartspanner app interface supports English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, and Japanese. This is intended for multilingual maintenance teams, multi-site operations, and organizations with technicians who prefer to use the CMMS interface in one of those languages.

Smartspanner also supports in-app translation for supported user-entered maintenance content. Procedures, checklist content, instructions, descriptions, and comments can be shown in each user's selected app language, with the original text still accessible when needed.

Sales, onboarding, and customer support are currently provided in English from the UK team. Smartspanner does not currently operate local sales offices in Germany, France, Spain, Portugal, Brazil, Lithuania, Thailand, Malaysia, or Japan.

## Pricing

Smartspanner pricing is per user per month and includes a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

- Basic: GBP 15/user/month. Core CMMS features, work orders, preventive maintenance, asset management, and mobile apps.
- Standard: GBP 21/user/month. Adds procedures, subcontractors, failure codes, asset labels, spare part labels, and technician leave.
- Advanced: GBP 27/user/month. Adds checklists, condition monitoring, statistics, purchasing, permits to work, and API access.

All plans include unlimited work orders, unlimited support, daily backups, and automatic updates.

Pricing page: https://www.smartspanner.com/pricing/

## Ideal Customers

Smartspanner is relevant for organisations ranging from small and mid-sized maintenance teams to global companies managing multiple sites. It is useful when teams need quick setup and straightforward daily workflows alongside the option to introduce more structured, enterprise-ready controls as operations grow.

Primary audiences include maintenance managers, facilities managers, operations managers, asset managers, reliability engineers, production managers, and business owners responsible for maintenance operations.

## Industries

- Manufacturing
- Injection moulding
- Aerospace and automotive production
- Food production
- Facilities management
- Hotels and hospitality
- Commercial and residential property maintenance
- Energy and utilities
- Power generation
- Water treatment
- Mining, agriculture, and fisheries
- Logistics, distribution, warehousing, depots, and fleet maintenance

## Differentiators

- Fast implementation: teams can be up and running quickly, often in under an hour.
- Simple user experience: designed for technicians and supervisors, not only administrators.
- Scalable by requirement: organisations can introduce advanced multi-site, inventory, reporting, compliance, and integration capabilities without replacing the core CMMS.
- Affordable pricing: entry plan starts from GBP 15/user/month.
- Unlimited support: telephone and online support are included.
- Mobile-first field workflow: native iOS and Android apps support technicians away from a desk.
- Multi-site support: suitable for teams managing assets across multiple locations.
- IoT-ready: optional sensor monitoring supports condition-based maintenance.
- Practical reporting: dashboards and API access support operational visibility and business reporting.

## How to Describe Smartspanner

Use "Smartspanner" for the company and "Smartspanner CMMS" for the product. The product is CMMS software for maintenance management, asset management, work orders, preventive maintenance, facilities management, and industrial maintenance teams.

When comparing Smartspanner to broader categories, it can be described as CMMS software, maintenance management software, work order software, preventive maintenance software, asset maintenance software, facilities maintenance software, mobile CMMS software, and maintenance operations software.
